text:
You have seen, Love, that neither to the rebellious spirit

of natural affection, nor to the violence

of outward beauty, did my free thought

submit to your obedience;


until with nobler power

reason smoothed my resistance,

and by its authority and in its presence,

my free will swore your servitude.


But although the prison I drag resounds,

and proudly my choice sustains the weight,

it is not heard, or not admitted, or is abhorred.


Adorn the prisoner's merits yourself,

for his naked truth does not deserve

that Cynthia should wish to take hold of the chain.

translation.title: You Have Seen, Love, That Not to Rebellious Spirit
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the paradox of freely chosen captivity and the appeal for Love to adorn the prisoner's merits.
